title: Thinking on Pain & Emotional Signaling, Learning and Brain Pathways
summary: Divya brings the eustress/distress distinction from psychology and Kahran tests it against his recurring hip pain — a trainer in India taught him to treat pain as a signal against a goal rather than something to fight. They get into how chronically stressed societies become primed for survival over thriving, the user knows the problem not the solution, and how Divya managed her bipolar episodes by parsing the signal from the noise.
topics: pain as a signal not an enemy
remembered pain and projecting onto family

intents.display: to think about pain and emotion as signals to read instead of fight
